name: dawn age
lore:
Before the first kingdoms of elf or dwarf, the world pulsed with a violent, unbridled vitality. This was the Dawn Age, an era of titans where the very soil felt the weight of gods walking as beasts. The ecology was one of terrifying scale: ferns as tall as watchtowers choked the steaming valleys, and predators the size of galleons stalked the primeval mists.

Behavior in this epoch was governed by the Law of the Great; there was no room for the small or the subtle. Dragons claimed the heavens as their birthright, while the Jotun-kin carved empires from the living mountains. Life did not merely exist; it surged, fueled by raw, leaking magics that birthed chimeras and behemoths. To walk these lands was to be a gnat amidst a clash of storms. It was a world of thunder, red in tooth and claw, where survival was the only prayer.
